baseline.overlay: Only identical benches/concurrent_writers.rs and its harness=false Cargo bench registration; no runtime edits.

candidate.overlay: Only the benchmark --round selection change; runtime engine is the recorded revision.

host.profile: bench: opt-level=3, thin LTO, one codegen unit

protocol: Five matched rounds. Baseline first in even rounds, candidate first in odd rounds. All 18 cases per round retain the harness alternating case order.
limitations: Five short paired rounds; no statistical no-regression threshold was predeclared.
No CPU affinity, cache flushing or controlled desktop activity; no other agent-started builds/tests overlapped timing.
No process memory or physical-device I/O measurement.
Point-update graph workload only; not relational footprint cost or sustained fairness.
